name: How to Tackle a Kitchen Remodel Without Losing Your Mind

step.name: Step 1: Consultation and Scope Definition (2-4 weeks)
step.text: What happens: This is where you clarify your vision, needs, and lifestyle for your new kitchen. AKN Design Group meets with you to discuss layout changes, desired features, appliance preferences, and overall aesthetic. We'll measure existing conditions and utilities. Who does it: The homeowner actively participates by sharing ideas; our design-build team guides the conversation and gathers crucial information. This phase includes initial concept discussions and setting project goals.

step.name: Step 2: Design and Material Selection (4-8 weeks)
step.text: What happens: Our team develops CAD-supported layouts and detailed designs based on your input. You’ll select cabinetry, countertops, backsplashes, flooring, lighting, and appliances. We focus on ensuring compatible product specifications and a cohesive design. Who does it: AKN Design Group’s designers work closely with you, presenting options and helping you make informed material choices. This phase also includes defining allowances and exclusions for the project.

step.name: Step 3: Budgeting and Contract Finalization (2-3 weeks)
step.text: What happens: We provide a detailed, upfront estimate and a written contract outlining the scope of work, payment milestones, change-order procedures, and warranty terms. This includes value engineering to help optimize costs without compromising quality. Who does it: AKN Design Group prepares all documentation, and the homeowner reviews and approves the final plan and contract. A clear work schedule tied to material lead times is established here.

step.name: Step 4: Permit Coordination and Material Ordering (3-8 weeks, can overlap)
step.text: What happens: For projects involving changes to plumbing, electrical, or structural elements, building permits and inspections are necessary. AKN Design Group takes responsibility for obtaining required approvals. Concurrently, we order all selected materials, accounting for lead times. Who does it: Our team manages all permit applications and material procurement. Homeowners might be asked to confirm specific material selections before ordering.

step.name: Step 5: Demolition and Rough-In Construction (2-4 weeks)
step.text: What happens: This phase begins with careful demolition of the existing kitchen. Then, rough plumbing, electrical, and HVAC work are completed according to the new layout. This is when any concealed issues, like water damage or outdated wiring, are addressed. Who does it: AKN Design Group’s skilled construction team performs the demolition and rough-in work, ensuring all systems are properly installed and up to code.

step.name: Step 6: Inspections and Installation of Finishes (4-8 weeks)
step.text: What happens: After rough-ins, necessary inspections are scheduled and passed. Then, the installation of cabinetry, flooring, countertops, backsplash tile, and lighting begins. Appliances are also installed. Who does it: Our construction team coordinates inspections and expertly installs all finishes, maintaining high craftsmanship standards.

step.name: Step 7: Final Touches and Walkthrough (1-2 weeks)
step.text: What happens: The project wraps up with final appliance hook-ups, plumbing fixtures, paint touch-ups, and thorough cleaning. A comprehensive final walkthrough ensures every detail meets your expectations. Who does it: AKN Design Group conducts the final checks, and the homeowner confirms satisfaction, leading to the final project completion. We ensure the kitchen is ready for you to enjoy, making for a truly managed process and an exceptional homeowner experience.
